G1_Pure_Consumer.definition: Primary consumption/use behavior; no qualifying production trajectory.

G2_Low_Producer.definition: Qualifying production behavior in the low-production band.

G3_High_Producer.definition: Qualifying production behavior at or above the high-production boundary.

G4_Iterative_Researcher.definition: Repeated production-and-revision trajectory meeting the preregistered criterion.

G5_Adversarial_Spam.definition: Behavior meeting the preregistered adversarial/spam criterion.

G6_Synthetic_AI.definition: Output generated by a version-pinned AI model under the acquisition protocol.

G7_Human_Expert.definition: Human expert/reference unit meeting preregistered expertise criteria.

classification_rule: Each analytical unit maps to exactly one cohort after provenance and codebook verification.
boundary_values: Must be populated from frozen source-specific operationalization before scientific generation; no post-hoc thresholds permitted.
